living_x0_from_rear.method: Living area starts 40 mm wall + 20 mm inside the rear face (xr = xB + t + 0.02)

usable_length.method: GLB living length: from 60 mm inside the rear wall to 360 mm behind the cab-seat backs (cab length estimated: vans 1650–1800 ±250 mm, buses 2100–2600 ±300 mm). Not a measurement.

usable_width.source: research/project_files/donors.json (ObjectWeave seed 2026-10-08); models/source/vehicles.py (GLB build input, 19 Nov 2026)
usable_width.method: Exterior width 2226 − 2 × 40 mm assumed wall (donors.json shellWallEachSideMm 40 ±15). No taper, trim or tumblehome allowed for.

standing_height.method: GLB living-area clear height = overall height 3200 − estimated floor 950 − 40 mm roof skin − 20 mm (build_camper.py: zc = H − t − 0.02)

floor_height.source: research/project_files/donors.json (ObjectWeave seed 2026-10-08); models/source/vehicles.py (GLB build input, 19 Nov 2026)
floor_height.method: Not published. Planning default from donors.json (vans 560 ±100 mm, Wider Body 580) / concept floor for bus bodies (LP 410 900 ±150, Eicher 950 ±150, Viking 1000 ±200)

wheel_arch.note: Interior intrusion is NOT modelled in the GLB layouts (the arches are cut only in the body side walls). Values below are donors.json planning defaults, not measurements.
